Which traversal finds shortest path lengths in an unweighted graph?
BFS visits vertices in layers of increasing edge distance.
Which element sits at the root of a min-heap?
The min-heap invariant makes each parent no greater than its children.
What does the merge step combine in merge sort?
Merging repeatedly takes the smaller front element from two sorted sequences.
Different keys map to the same bucket
A collision occurs when distinct keys map to the same bucket; a collision strategy resolves it.
Dijkstra’s usual shortest-path algorithm requires what edge-weight condition?
Nonnegative edges make the greedy choice of the smallest unsettled distance safe.
A topological ordering exists for which directed graphs?
A directed cycle prevents all edges from pointing forward in a linear ordering.
Memoization records subproblem results for later reuse.
With items = [1, 2, 3], what does items.pop() return?
With no index, list.pop removes and returns the last item.
What does list.sort() return after sorting a list in place?
Mutating list methods such as sort return None rather than a new list.
What does an empty pair of braces, {}, create in Python?
An empty set is written set(); {} creates an empty dictionary.
Which value can be a Python dictionary key?
Dictionary keys must be hashable. Strings qualify; lists, dictionaries, and mutable sets do not.
Which collection is recommended for efficient insertion and removal at both ends?
A list used only at index zero
A deque supports efficient operations at both ends, making it useful for queues.
What is [x * x for x in [1, 2, 3]]?
The expression squares each input element and collects the results in a list.
Which state is normally private to an individual thread?
Threads share process resources but each needs its own stack and execution state.
Two threads both read 0, add one, and write 1. What happened?
A correct final count of two
The read-modify-write steps interleaved, causing one increment to overwrite the other.

Any function longer than ten lines

What should a Raft server do when it sees a term higher than its own?
Update its term and become a follower

How many candidates may a Raft server vote for in one term?
As many as arrive before a heartbeat
Each server records at most one vote per term, helping ensure election safety.
What normally prevents a Raft follower from starting an election?
Leader contact resets the follower’s election timeout.
In a five-node Raft cluster split into groups of three and two, which side can form a majority?
A majority of five is three. The minority cannot independently elect a leader.
Why do any two majority quorums overlap?
Each contains more than half of the same membership
They have identical logs by definition
Two disjoint sets cannot both contain more than half of the same finite membership.
What is PostgreSQL’s default transaction isolation level?
PostgreSQL defaults to Read Committed; applications may request a stronger level.
In PostgreSQL, Read Uncommitted behaves like which level?
PostgreSQL maps Read Uncommitted to Read Committed, so dirty reads are not allowed.
At Read Committed in PostgreSQL, a SELECT sees a snapshot from when?
The beginning of the database’s lifetime
Each command normally sees data committed before that command began.
How should an application respond to a serialization failure?
Ignore the error and reuse partial results
Serializable execution can abort a conflicting transaction. The application must retry the whole transaction.
A repeated predicate query returns additional matching rows. Which anomaly is this?
A phantom concerns a change in the set of rows matching a search condition.
